file a complaint: After waiting two hours for his food, he decided to file a complaint with the restaurant manager.
等餐等了兩個小時之後，他決定向餐廳經理提出申訴。
file a lawsuit: His lawyer went to the court office on Monday to file a lawsuit against the company that cheated him.
他的律師週一到法院辦公室，對那家欺騙他的公司提告。
file a report: After the car accident, the police officer had to file a report about what happened on the road.
車禍發生後，警員必須提交一份報告，說明路上發生了什麼事。
file for divorce: After years of fighting with her husband, she finally decided to file for divorce last spring.
和丈夫爭吵多年之後，她終於在去年春天決定訴請離婚。
file documents: The secretary spends every morning trying to file documents in the cabinet by date and name.
秘書每天早上都花時間把文件按日期和名稱歸檔到櫃子裡。
filter information: Students should learn to filter information online, keeping what is useful and ignoring what is false.
學生應該學會過濾網路資訊，保留有用的，忽略錯誤的。
filter out noise: These new headphones can filter out noise from the street, so I can study in peace.
這副新耳機能濾除街上的雜音，讓我能安靜地讀書。
news filtered through: The news filtered through to the small mountain village a week after the election was over.
選舉結束一週後，消息才慢慢傳到那個小山村。
filter water: When camping in the forest, we always filter water from the stream before we drink it.
在森林露營時，我們總是先過濾溪水才喝。
finance a project: The city government agreed to use tax money to finance a project that will build a new library.
市政府同意用稅金資助一項興建新圖書館的計畫。
finance one's studies: She worked part-time at a coffee shop every evening to finance her studies at the university.
她每天晚上在咖啡店打工，來支付自己的大學學費。
finance the war: The king raised taxes again and again to finance the war, and the people grew very poor.
國王一再加稅來籌措戰費，人民因此變得非常貧窮。
fire an employee: The boss had no choice but to fire an employee who kept stealing money from the shop.
老闆別無選擇，只好開除一名一直偷店裡錢的員工。
fire questions at: As soon as the actor stepped out of the car, reporters began to fire questions at him.
演員一下車，記者們就開始連珠炮似地向他發問。
fire up the crowd: The band played its most famous song first to fire up the crowd before the big concert.
樂團先演奏最有名的歌，在大型演唱會前炒熱群眾。
fire a gun: Soldiers are trained never to fire a gun at people who are not carrying any weapons.
士兵受過訓練，絕不向沒有攜帶武器的人開槍。
fire one's imagination: Stories about space travel fire his imagination and make him dream of becoming an astronaut one day.
太空旅行的故事激發他的想像，讓他夢想有一天成為太空人。
fish for information: My nosy neighbor likes to fish for information about our family by chatting with my little brother.
我那愛管閒事的鄰居喜歡透過和我弟弟聊天，套話打聽我們家的事。
fish out one's keys: Standing at the door in the rain, she tried to fish out her keys from her messy bag.
她站在雨中的門口，試著從凌亂的包包裡掏出鑰匙。
fish in troubled waters: Some dishonest businessmen fish in troubled waters, raising prices sharply when a typhoon hits the island.
有些不老實的商人混水摸魚，在颱風侵襲島上時大幅抬高價格。
fix a date: We should fix a date for our class reunion soon so that everyone can mark it on their calendars.
我們應該盡快訂好同學會的日期，好讓大家都能在行事曆上做記號。
fix a meal: Mom came home late, so she could only fix a quick meal of noodles and eggs for us.
媽媽很晚才回家，所以只能為我們很快做一頓麵和蛋的飯。
fix a match: Several players were paid by gamblers to fix a match and lose the game on purpose.
幾名球員收了賭徒的錢打假球，故意輸掉比賽。
fix one's eyes on: During the whole magic show, the little girl would fix her eyes on the magician's hands.
整場魔術表演中，小女孩都一直盯著魔術師的手。
fix the problem: The engineer worked all night to fix the problem with the computer system before the office opened.
工程師熬夜工作，要在辦公室開門前解決電腦系統的問題。
be in a fix: If you miss the last bus tonight, you will be in a fix because taxis are rare here.
如果你今晚錯過末班公車，你會陷入困境，因為這裡很少計程車。
flame with anger: Her eyes seemed to flame with anger when she found out that her best friend had lied to her.
當她發現最好的朋友騙了她，她的眼睛彷彿怒火中燒。
old flame: At the class reunion, he was surprised to meet an old flame he had dated in high school.
在同學會上，他很驚訝遇見高中時交往過的舊情人。
fan the flames: Instead of calming the two angry groups, his rude comments online only fan the flames of their fight.
他在網路上的無禮言論不但沒有平息兩群憤怒的人，反而在他們的爭吵中煽風點火。
burst into flames: The old wooden house suddenly burst into flames, and the family ran outside just in time.
那棟老木屋突然起火燃燒，一家人及時跑到屋外。
